entities.name: Vlado Petković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vlado Petković is a Serbian volleyball player. He plays as setter. He is currently playing for Crvena zvezda. He played for the national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing and 2012 Summer Olympics in London.
